module_summary: 8-to-16 width converter: collects two 8-bit inputs over two cycles and outputs combined 16-bit value using toggle-flag state machine.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input valid signal triggers state transitions for data collection and output generation.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Input data stream (8-bit) collected and buffered for width expansion.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Output valid pulse indicates 16-bit combined result ready; one pulse per two inputs.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Output port carries 16-bit combined data: {data_lock, data_in} on every second valid input.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Buffer holding first 8-bit value until second arrives for width concatenation.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: 2-state toggle flag: 0=collect first byte to buffer, 1=collect second byte and output combined.

groups.name: State machine
groups.description: Toggle flag controls buffering vs. output phase of width conversion.

groups.name: Data buffering
groups.description: Holding register for first byte while waiting for second input.

groups.name: Input/output interface
groups.description: Valid-based handshake: accepts 8-bit inputs, outputs 16-bit combined result every two cycles.
